question: Who built the Jal Mandir related to Jainism?
solution:
The correct answer is __**King Nandivardhan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **King Nandivardhan** is credited with the construction of the Jal Mandir related to Jainism.
 
• The Jal Mandir is a significant Jain temple located in Pawapuri, Bihar.
 
• It is said to mark the place where Lord Mahavira, the 24th Tirthankara of Jainism, attained Nirvana.
 
• The temple is situated in the middle of a lotus pond and is an important pilgrimage site for Jains.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jainism is an ancient Indian religion that emphasizes non-violence and asceticism.
 
• Lord Mahavira, born as Vardhamana, is considered the founder of Jainism and is one of the most revered figures in the religion.
 
• The Jal Mandir is one of the five main temples in Pawapuri and attracts numerous devotees and tourists every year.
 
• King Nandivardhan was the elder brother of Lord Mahavira and played a significant role in spreading Jainism.
 
• The temple's serene setting and spiritual significance make it a unique and sacred site for the Jain community.
